leads.title: US Ties Sudanese Army Chief's UN Visa to Ceasefire Deal
leads.thesis: Washington is reportedly withholding Gen. al-Burhan's visa to pressure Sudan's army into a ceasefire framework ahead of UNGA.

leads.title: UNGA Gaza Push: Board of Peace, Qatar Mediation and Erdogan's 'Genocidal Mindset' Charge
leads.thesis: Parallel Gaza diplomacy tracks converge at UNGA — a Board of Peace reiterating objectives, Qatar insisting diplomacy must not fail, and Erdogan's blistering UN attack on Israel.

leads.title: Trump's India-Pakistan Mediation Claim — 'Saved 30 Million Lives'
leads.thesis: At UNGA, Trump repeats claim he stopped an India-Pakistan war, praising Pakistan's Shehbaz Sharif as 'terrific man' — a narrative India has not endorsed.

leads.title: India Co-Sponsors Partners for Multilateralism Summit at UN
leads.thesis: India co-sponsors inaugural Partners for Multilateralism summit at UN, pitching reformed multilateralism amid UNGA power-bloc tensions.

leads.title: Ukraine's Refinery Strikes Deepen Global 'Refining Crisis'
leads.thesis: Chinese coverage frames Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries as exacerbating a global refining crunch, not just battlefield damage.

leads.title: Trump Reportedly Called Off Houthi Strikes as Bombs Were Being Loaded
leads.thesis: Report claims Trump aborted imminent Houthi strikes at last minute, even as Houthis continue attacks and Saudi faces multi-front pressure.

leads.title: Trump Said to Pressure Zelensky to Sign Ceasefire at UN Summit
leads.thesis: Taiwan press reports Trump plans to pressure Zelensky into a ceasefire deal on UNGA sidelines — a high-stakes diplomatic theater.

leads.title: US-Iran Shuttle Talks Resume After Months — Oil Risk Premium Lingers
leads.thesis: First US-Iran shuttle talks in months raise hope for progress, but UNGA brings no leader meeting and oil markets keep risk premium.

leads.title: Trump-Xi Summit Live: Xi En Route to US Amid Lavish Welcome Debate
leads.thesis: Xi Jinping travels to US for Trump-Xi summit as China hawks grumble over lavish welcome and Al Jazeera frames smiles over table, kicks underneath.

leads.title: China's New Travel Rules Rattle Tech Giants and Talent
leads.thesis: Beijing's new outbound travel restrictions unsettle tech firms and skilled workers, raising brain-drain and compliance costs.

leads.title: China Cracks Down on Myanmar Scam Centres
leads.thesis: China intensifies crackdown on scam compounds in neighboring Myanmar, a major source of telecom fraud and human trafficking.

leads.title: Netanyahu vs Mamdani Escalates Ahead of UNGA
leads.thesis: Israeli PM Netanyahu vows to 'tell the truth' about NYC mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani, nationalizing a local race into UNGA geopolitics.

leads.title: AT&T Is Automating Away Its Old Telecom Empire
leads.thesis: Wired reports AT&T is aggressively automating jobs and dismantling legacy telecom operations, a case study in AI-driven industrial restructuring.

leads.title: OpenAI Talent Raid: Patreon Execs and Elite Mathematicians Panel
leads.thesis: OpenAI hires key Patreon executives ahead of announcement and convenes elite mathematicians to avoid fumbling superintelligence — a two-pronged talent/legitimacy push.

leads.title: Grab + OpenAI Bring AI Skills to Southeast Asia
leads.thesis: Grab and OpenAI partner to deliver practical AI skills across Southeast Asia, leveraging super-app distribution.

leads.title: Microsoft Disrupts AI-Assisted Crime Platform That Compromised 12,000 Accounts
leads.thesis: Microsoft takes down AI-assisted platform that compromised 12,000 accounts, alongside reports of AI hive-mind malware and Muse 0-day.

leads.title: Google DeepMind Launches Gemini 3.8 Live with Extended Thinking
leads.thesis: DeepMind introduces Gemini 3.8 Live and Extended Thinking variant, pushing real-time multimodal reasoning.

leads.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna plus Better Prompt Caching
leads.thesis: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 Sol and Luna variants and improved prompt caching for GPT-6, targeting cost and latency for long-context use.

leads.title: AI Infrastructure Boom: Snorkel Triples to $3.5B, Rabbit's Agent, HF Transformers Quants
leads.thesis: Snorkel AI triples valuation on training-data demand, Rabbit ships R1-free agent, and Hugging Face Transformers now runs llama.cpp quants — infrastructure layer heats up.

leads.title: UK AISI EvalEval and oMLX Join HF: Making Benchmarks Reproducible
leads.thesis: UK AI Safety Institute's EvalEval aims for reproducible benchmarks while oMLX creator joins Hugging Face to support MLX community.

leads.title: The Virtual Border Wall's Deadly Failures — Mapping Deaths Along the Border
leads.thesis: MIT Technology Review roundtables and methodology piece map deaths along US 'virtual wall' of towers and surveillance, questioning efficacy and human cost.

leads.title: US Superintelligence Strategy and the AI Race Framing Debate
leads.thesis: Import AI details US superintelligence strategy while Rest of World argues America is in wrong AI race with China and Dario Amodei's slowdown call is rejected by Beijing.

leads.title: Quantum Advantage for Distributed Symmetry Breaking and Error Suppression
leads.thesis: Two arXiv papers claim quantum advantage in distributed symmetry breaking and error suppression with heterogeneous-distance lattice surgery for distributed quantum computing.

leads.title: Optical Ion Clock Engineered to Resist Motion-Induced Shifts
leads.thesis: New optical ion clock design claims engineered immunity to motion-induced frequency shifts, a key barrier to portable ultra-precise timekeeping.

leads.title: Huge Iron Age Metal Bars Hoard Hints at Vast Trade Network
leads.thesis: Nature reports huge hoard of Iron Age metal bars suggesting far larger and more organized trade than assumed.

leads.title: Decoding the Secret Cellular Language of Plants
leads.thesis: Phys.org feature on reading leaves to decode plants' cellular signaling language — intercellular communication mechanisms.

leads.title: One of America's Largest Reservoirs Hits Record Low
leads.thesis: ScienceDaily reports one of America's largest reservoirs just hit record low, spotlighting drought and water management stress.

leads.title: Space Roundup: Curiosity 5,000 Days, Juice Earth Flyby, New Lunar Crater McGetchin, Tiny Body Rings Evolve
leads.thesis: Curiosity marks 5,000 days with top 10 Mars photos, ESA's Juice heads for third Earth gravity assist, NASA names new lunar crater McGetchin, and rings around a tiny body have changed in a decade.

leads.title: CATL's 100 GWh Battery Factory Starts Trial Production
leads.thesis: CATL begins trial runs on two lines of its 100 GWh EV battery plant — massive scale for global EV supply chain.

leads.title: Heathrow Expansion Could Make Flights 80% of UK Emissions by 2050
leads.thesis: UK Climate Change Committee warns Heathrow expansion could push aviation to 80% of UK emissions by 2050, challenging net-zero plans.

leads.title: Virus-Like Jumping Genes as Partners in Human Evolution
leads.thesis: Quanta explains how virus-like jumping genes became co-opted as partners in evolution, shaping human genome regulation.

leads.title: LHC Rules Out Another Hiding Place for Quantum Black Holes
leads.thesis: LHC results rule out another parameter space where quantum black holes might hide, tightening constraints on extra dimensions.

leads.title: Venus Sulfur Clouds Might Not Be So Inhospitable
leads.thesis: Eos reports research suggesting Venusian sulfur clouds may be less inhospitable than thought, reopening habitability questions.

leads.title: Super El Niño Could Cause 15,800 Extra Heat Deaths in India
leads.thesis: Projection warns this year's Super El Niño could cause 15,800 additional heat deaths in India, spotlighting climate-health nexus.

leads.title: Famine Threatens Oleshky in Russian-Occupied Kherson
leads.thesis: DW reports famine threatens Oleshky in southern Kherson amid war and occupation, with disrupted supply and agriculture.

leads.title: Indonesia Ferry Capsize Death Toll Rises to 26, 109 Missing
leads.thesis: Death toll from capsized ship in Indonesia rises to 26 with 109 still missing as search continues.

leads.title: Ethnic Clash Kills 15 in Kebbi, Nigeria — Residents Flee
leads.thesis: Armed ethnic clash in Bagudo, Kebbi kills 15 including village head, displacing residents.

leads.title: Myanmar Female Political Prisoners Face Torture and Neglect — HRW
leads.thesis: Human Rights Watch reports women held as political prisoners in Myanmar face torture and neglect in detention.

leads.title: Trump's FBI Shut Down Defense Contractor Bribery Probe — Report
leads.thesis: Defense One reports Trump's FBI shut down investigation into alleged bribes by defense contractor, raising politicization concerns.

leads.title: Philippine Senate Lowers Conviction Threshold in Sara Duterte Trial
leads.thesis: Philippine Senate lowers threshold needed to convict VP Sara Duterte in impeachment trial, altering political math.

leads.title: 'Super Intelligence' — President's New Term for AI Explained
leads.thesis: Defense One explainer on president's new term 'Super Intelligence' for AI, alongside Greece PM's 'fighting yesterday's battle' warning and hype critique.

leads.title: Health Watch: Ozempic Lawsuits Over Vision Loss, UnitedHealth Fights RPM Curbs, Sex/Gender in Guidelines
leads.thesis: GLP-1 drugs face US lawsuits over rare vision loss, UnitedHealth/CVS push back on Medicare remote monitoring curbs, and Nature Medicine urges sex/gender in treatment guidelines.

leads.title: Light Tail: Colosseum Closure, Hong Kong Family Leave, Takaichi Tax Cut, and Other Administrative Moves
leads.thesis: Italy's Colosseum closes after worker death, Hong Kong pledges lenient 10-12 hour family leave for civil servants, Japan's Takaichi pushes tax cut bill, plus other local administrative news.
